scientific_integrity: The Anti-Foundation sources are credited for the finite connected-component realization theorem, and Frucht/Sabidussi for finite connected graphs with prescribed finite automorphism group. The retained contribution is the uniform closed-wreath-subgroup consequence and its topological corollaries. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives closed subgroup lower bounds for automorphism groups of countable double-membership graphs. It does not classify the full automorphism group, prove normality of the displayed subgroups, or describe automorphisms of infinite connected components.
title: Every anti-foundation double-membership graph has universal closed wreath subgroups
